biotools.summary: OncoContour is an interactive, web-based platform designed for the geographic visualization and demographic analysis of cancer incidence data. It allows users to analyze cancer trends across different regions and population demographics.
biotools.name: OncoContour: Geographic Cancer Visualization Platform
